Name: Cornucopia Artisan Machines Cometkins Style
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
This mod features a combination of original artwork and various edited assets from all of Cometkins's visual mods. This mod is also completely configurable, so you can toggle the retextured icons at your discretion. However, this mod has not been tested at length, so some errors may persist. Please report any errors that you find, and I'll try to fix them as soon as possible.
